title: Aligned but Stereotypical? The Hidden Influence of System Prompts on Social Bias in LVLM-Based Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating perceived gender in generated images using an LVLM-as-a-judge (VQA) to calculate a Fair Discrepancy (FD) score, supplemented by mechanistic analyses of token probability shifts and text embedding associations in the model's text encoder.

Evaluating perceived age categories (e.g., young, adult, old) in generated images using an LVLM-as-a-judge to calculate a Fair Discrepancy (FD) score, and analyzing age-related word frequencies in decoded intermediate texts.
Evaluating perceived ethnicity in generated images using an LVLM-as-a-judge to calculate a Fair Discrepancy (FD) score, and analyzing ethnicity-related word frequencies in decoded intermediate texts.
Evaluating perceived body type and appearance (e.g., slim, average, athletic, overweight) in generated images using an LVLM-as-a-judge to calculate a Fair Discrepancy (FD) score.
